build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: Simulate multiple autonomous agents with visible goals, sensing range, energy, memory, and behavior-state transitions such as explore, seek, avoid, rest, and cooperate. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Let players adjust temperature, gravity magnitude and direction, resource density, hazard level, and time scale with responsive controls. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Click an agent to inspect its current perception, target, energy, recent decisions, and trajectory, highlighting sensed objects in the habitat. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Display live charts for entropy, population energy, movement diversity, collisions, resource use, and agent-state distribution. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

Provide repeatable experiment scenarios with hypotheses and success conditions, plus seeded reset and side-by-side result comparison. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

Make environmental changes visibly affect trajectories and group behavior without instantly teleporting or directly scripting agents. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

Completed experiments unlock new sensors, agent traits, environment presets, and more complex multi-variable research objectives. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

The HUD clearly communicates current objective, critical resources, selected target or mode, progress, and danger states in stable regions. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from the game state at 1280x720.

Every important player action has immediate, distinguishable feedback for valid input, invalid input, success, damage or failure, and state change. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from the game state at 1280x720.

The full loop is connected: styled title and start flow, playable core systems, progression or escalation, final success/failure state, and retry or return navigation all work without reloading the page. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from the game state at 1280x720.

The project has a coherent authored art direction: A clean scientific glass-box diorama with soft laboratory lighting, distinct agent colors, translucent sensor cones, plotted trajectories, and precise dashboard graphics. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes. Full credit may be earned with runtime-authored procedural textures, layered materials, deliberate multi-light rigs, particles, synthesized audio, or post-processing; external asset files are not required.

The 3D environment has deliberate composition, lighting, material contrast, depth cues, and themed landmarks rather than an empty floor with scattered objects. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.
